budget_note: Every --check on a distinct spec is a candidate. Ships 3 views; each view's candidate list is at the 3-candidate cap or below. All candidates, orientation probes and frame dumps were run through scripts/viz-evidence.sh record (no hand-kept probe output).

views.subject: the anti-parallel worker RPC seam (worker <-> runtime), co-viewed

attempts.check: extent=61x5; labels 1/2 placed, 1 skipped, 0 ambiguous; crossings 0/0
attempts.rejected_because: lr without label_slot: place_label offsets a horizontal run's label into the row above/below the run, and the layout reserved no such row for a 21-char label, so e0 ("task input + ctrl RPCs") was skipped (stderr: no clear cell).

attempts.check: extent=44x7; labels 2/2 placed, 0 skipped, 0 ambiguous; crossings 0/0
attempts.why_kept: Both reverse directions are separate edges in one frame with distinct labels and distinct ports, and label_slot reserves the gutter rows the labels need. Chosen over v1-pair (skipped label) and v1-pair-c (both labels skipped).

attempts.check: extent=26x29; labels 0/2 placed, 2 skipped, 0 ambiguous; crossings 0/0
attempts.rejected_because: tb orientation: for a vertical run place_label sets the label beside the column, which needs horizontal flank room the layout never reserves, so both long labels were skipped.

views.subject: modal-runtime's callee fan (task engine, modal-daemon over HTTP on UDS)

attempts.check: extent=59x9; labels 2/2 placed, 0 skipped, 0 ambiguous; crossings 0/0
attempts.why_kept: Each label sits on its own route's row beside that route's run (frame rows 4 and 8 of the pinned dump); the two callees are separated by hue (engine = control family with runtime, daemon = agents family).

attempts.check: extent=59x9; labels 2/2 placed, 0 skipped, 0 ambiguous; crossings 0/0
attempts.rejected_because: orientation probe: nodes declared daemon-before-engine to try to put Task engine above modal-daemon (source lists the engine dispatch, e3, before the daemon seam, e8). The render was byte-identical to v2-fan, so node declaration order does not control the across-axis order in lr. Kept as the measurement for the recorded order deviation.

attempts.check: extent=41x27; labels 2/2 placed, 0 skipped, 1 ambiguous owner; crossings 0/0
attempts.rejected_because: tb orientation fixed nothing and introduced an ambiguous owner: both long labels stacked on the same flank of one two-column corridor, so one of them sits as close to the other route as to its own.

views.subject: task dispatch, container backend and storage (engine, backend, container, filesystem, blobnet)

attempts.check: extent=55x55; labels 4/4 placed, 0 skipped, 0 ambiguous; crossings 0/0
attempts.rejected_because: 55 rows of extent exceed the 47-row target: the frames dump at COLUMNS=77 LINES=47 shows 'graph overflows · drag to pan'. Labels without a reserved gutter cost rank-row height.

attempts.check: extent=66x20; labels 4/4 placed, 0 skipped, 0 ambiguous; crossings 0/0
attempts.rejected_because: label_slot on all four edges fixed the height (20 rows) but the group tag 'storage' resolves to hue family 1 (RGB 183,206,115) in this build - the same family as the 'agents' tag used by v1/v2 (measured from the border colours in evidence/v1/v1-ansi.ansi and evidence/v3/v3-ansi.ansi), so two of the case's four groups shared one hue.

attempts.check: extent=66x20; labels 4/4 placed, 0 skipped, 0 ambiguous; crossings 0/0; groups control(1) compute(2) volumes(2)
attempts.why_kept: Same layout as v2-b with the storage tag renamed to the source-worded 'volumes' (source: 'Filesystem + volumes', 'image + volume data'), whose hue family is 5 (RGB 138,115,206) - distinct from agents/control/compute. Border colours re-measured from the fresh capture: engine (206,115,138), backend (115,161,206), filesystem (138,115,206), container (153,186,219), blobnet (170,153,219).
